text:
ana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem focused on vendor/dependency mitigations. I extracted actionable items; please ack and take ownership of one.

omar: Ack. Paste the items here so I can slot into my sprint.

ana: (1) cross-cloud artifact mirror + manual failover runbook, (2) registry client resilience: cached manifests + retry/circuit-breaker, (3) auth provider: single-flight token refresh + refresh healthcheck, (4) vendor escalation matrix + faster P1 engagement ask, (5) monthly recurrence report + lightweight digest.

omar: I'll take (1). Plan: build a minimal cross-cloud read-only mirror (copy artifacts to backup bucket in different provider every 6h) + short runbook commands to flip DNS and TTL. ETA runbook draft: 2026-04-09. Will include a reconcile check to verify checksums after failover.

pierre: I'll own (2). Proposal: add a small redis-backed manifest cache with schema-versioned entries (TTL 3m), client retries with capped exponential backoff, and a circuit-breaker that opens on sustained 5xxs. ETA feature branch by 2026-04-01. Will add integration test simulating registry 502/503.

sarah: I'll take (3) token single-flight and healthcheck. Implement single-flight per-client-key to avoid stampedes and synthetic probe every 60s that verifies token issuance latency. Also add a short fail-open window (30s) to reduce customer impact during brief provider blips. ETA: 2026-03-27.

vendor-eng: For (4) I'm collecting primary + escalation contacts for provider-Y and will request a written faster-engagement SLA. Expect initial contact card and proposed email template by 2026-03-24.

ana: For (5) recurrence report: we need a small Grafana panel that counts vendor-related incidents over 30/90/180 days and a weekly slack digest. Who can spin up the panel?

omar: I can wire a staging panel and set a weekly job to post a short summary to #incidents. ETA: 2026-04-02.

ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-899 and linked to the incident board.

pierre: Telemetry note: emit structured event when serving cached manifest or triggering failover: fields: event_type, reason, cached_age_ms, affected_route, owner_team. Keep it terse.

sarah: Also log when single-flight prevents concurrent refreshes and when we enter fail-open: event=token_refresh_single_flight, event=token_fail_open.

omar: Risk for mirror: eventual consistency. I'll include a verification job and document time-to-sync expectations in the runbook.

ana: Owners recap: omar (mirror + runbook + reconcile) -> 2026-04-09; pierre (cached manifests + retries + CB + tests) -> 2026-04-01; sarah (token single-flight + healthcheck) -> 2026-03-27; vendor-eng (contacts + SLA ask) -> 2026-03-24; omar (recurrence panel + weekly digest) -> 2026-04-02.

ops-bot: Reminder: INC-2026-899 triage check in 48h.

ana: Thanks all. Please add PRs/tickets to INC-2026-899 and react with :white_check_mark: when linked. We'll review progress in the weekly triage; escalate if ETAs slip.
